fields.summary_ko.0: Saudi PIF concentrates 80.2% of its U.S. equity portfolio in SpaceX (SPCX at $150.86, SpaceX holdings valued at $23.25B).
fields.summary_ko.1: Following EA's take-private completion, PIF's SpaceX stake increased from 69.5% to 80.2%, while SpaceX's per-share value declined from $170.86 to $150.86 over the same period.
